cohort: 18,946 women with births >34 weeks gestation between 2017 and 2019 in a large academic hospital system. Excluded: multiple gestations, vaginal birth after cesarean, elective repeat or primary cesarean delivery, and contraindications for vaginal delivery
finding: Black and Asian women had significantly increased odds of unplanned cesarean delivery compared to White women, even after adjusting for age, BMI, parity, and zip code income strata, and rates of unplanned cesarean delivery were higher for Hispanic women self-identifying as single.
mod_finding: Racial and ethnic differences were seen in cesarean delivery indications and operative vaginal deliveries.
